US Drone Fleet Depleted in Iran Conflict, Report Claims

A report indicates the U.S. military has lost approximately 25% of its MQ-9 Reaper drone fleet, totaling at least 45 drones, in the conflict with Iran. The estimated financial loss exceeds $1.3 billion, with individual drones costing up to $50 million. This depletion has raised concerns about future supply capabilities for potential hostilities. Separately, U.S. President Trump ordered a reduction in joint military exercises with South Korea, citing South Korea's alleged refusal to assist in Iran's denuclearization.
